name: Quebec: income and sales tax, 2026
name_fr: Québec : impôt sur le revenu et taxes de vente, 2026
description: Provincial/territorial personal income tax brackets, basic personal amount and sales tax rates for Quebec for the 2026 tax year, with estimated take-home pay for a single employee at three salaries.

attributes.health_premium: Quebec: 1% contribution by individuals to the Health Services Fund has 2026 thresholds of $18,500 and $64,355 (Quebec MoF); which income it applies to was not verified in this pass and it is not modelled. Quebec's public prescription-drug plan charges an income-based premium to members (PMPRB summary) — amount not captured.
attributes.payroll: QPP 6.30% (+4% QPP2 band), EI 1.30%, QPIP 0.43% — see nat-ca-federal-income-tax-and-payroll-2026

sales_tax.note: HST replaces GST and PST in participating provinces. PST/QST bases and exemptions differ from GST and are set provincially; only headline rates are recorded here.

attributes.notes: Quebec administers its own income tax (Revenu Québec); CRA does not publish Quebec brackets. Quebec residents' basic federal tax is reduced by the 16.5% Quebec abatement. Quebec employees pay QPP, reduced-rate EI and QPIP instead of CPP and full EI. Indexation 2.05% for 2026.

sources.title: Parameters of the Personal Income Tax System for 2026 (November 2025), Table 3
Taux d'imposition (Quebec income tax rates) — fetch returned HTTP 403 twice; rates taken from the search-engine extract of this page and of Revenu Québec's 'Principal changes for 2026' employer page
T4032-QC Payroll Deductions Tables, January 2026, general information (Quebec abatement 16.5%, Quebec EI rate)
GST/HST calculator (and rates for provinces) — rates on or after 1 April 2025; page modified 2025-04-01

verification.notes: Bracket thresholds and BPA read directly from the Quebec Finance ministry's 2026 parameters (PDF). The four rates (14/19/24/25.75%) come from search-engine extracts of Revenu Québec pages because revenuquebec.ca returned HTTP 403 to two fetch attempts.

limitations: Headline rates only: no refundable credits, low-income reductions, dividend or capital-gains treatment, or property taxes. The net-pay figures in attributes are estimates (method in nat-ca-take-home-pay-examples-2026), not official figures.
